messages: Zoe: posted a new compact mock for the vectors batch preview. major ask: reduce accidental exports. figma: https://figma.redwood/batch-preview/inline-panel :eyes: Mark: thanks — immediate thought: make Preview the prominent action and hide Export behind kebab. users keep hitting Export by mistake when scanning the toolbar Chen: backend impact: those accidental exports spin up heavy jobs and we see queue spikes. prefer putting Export behind a menu + require explicit confirm with approximate size shown Leah (PM): can we also improve copy? 'Export vectors' is vague. Suggest 'Export selected vectors (.csv)' and show row count + sample header before confirming ops-bot: note: we currently throttle export jobs at infra level but they still affect latency for interactive previews when many run concurrently a11y-reviewer: accessibility items: - keyboard/tab order must match visual priority (Preview first). - when export modal opens, screen reader should announce: "Export selected vectors. Sample header: id, vector_0,..." - avoid relying on color to convey relevance in preview rows Zoe: proposal: 1) Toolbar: Primary=Preview (solid), Secondary=Save (outline), Overflow contains Export and Export all. 2) Export flow: open inline panel (not full modal) that shows sample CSV header, estimated size (~2.3 MB) and checkbox "Include metadata". 3) Confirm button reads: "Export (~2.3 MB)" Mark: inline panel is a nice compromise — less disruptive than modal and keeps context. Make sure focus traps properly and close returns to the kebab button Chen: we can return a fast estimate of bytes for selected rows from the API before enqueuing. We'll also mark export jobs as low priority and emit progress events so UI can show a toaster + link when ready Leah (PM): timeline: can we ship toolbar reorder + copy + inline panel skeleton in the next patch? full confirm modal + job-priority tuning can be follow-up a11y-reviewer: also: add visually hidden text for the relevance gradient: e.g., Relevance: High and an icon for non-color cue. NVDA and VoiceOver test cases for the panel open/close should be added Zoe: added a tiny code snippet for the CSV header in the mock: ```id,vector_0,vector_1,...,metadata``` will include that in the panel and in the export email copy Mark: copy nit: toast text -> "Your vectors export is queued. We'll email a download link when ready." In the panel CTA: "Export and Queue" vs "Export now"? lean to "Export (~2.3 MB)" Chen: backend plan: estimate -> show size -> enqueue low-priority job -> emit progress -> store download on S3 and send signed link. ETA PR in 2 sprints for full flow, quick UI changes in current sprint Leah (PM): consensus: reorder toolbar, move Export to overflow, add inline export panel with sample header and filesize estimate, keyboard/focus fixes, SR announcements, and clearer copy. Follow-ups: rate-limiting controls and detailed confirm modal Zoe: I'll update Figma and add keyboard-only screencast + aria notes. tagging the group when uploaded :slightly_smiling_face: Chen: adding infra ticket for low-priority export buckets and progress hooks Mark: thanks all. small follow-up: consider an "Are you sure?" banner when selection > 5k rows to prevent huge accidental exports Leah (PM): noted — add that to the follow-up scope. closing thread for now
